# Translation into the Programme

Where the postquantum theory rhymes with this project, where the rhyme is misleading, and what could actually be imported. The reframing itself is [[vendor/postquantum-gravity/commentary/descent-instead-of-diffusion|descent instead of diffusion]]; this note handles types and construction targets, and refuses identities the mathematics does not license.

## The object of inquiry is different

The vendor asks how a classical spacetime can consistently carry quantum matter. The programme asks what makes an arena of facts one cosmos. These are not the same question, and the vendor's classical sector is not the programme's descent even where the formulas rhyme. Two differences are structural rather than incidental.

The vendor postulates the classical-quantum split as fundamental. The programme treats the accessible/inaccessible division as *indexed by a declared family*, per commitment PC2 of [[program-core/axioms-and-principles|the axiom and principle ledger]], and therefore as something to be constructed rather than assumed. A theory in which the split is fundamental has answered by fiat a question the programme intends to derive.

The vendor's diffusion is a dynamical process in time. The programme's descent is, so far, a structural relation among contexts. Nothing yet maps one to the other, and the passage from a poset of contexts to an ordered history is the open problem of [[philosophy/indiscernibility-of-identicals/why-there-is-difference|why there is difference at all]].

## A typed dictionary

| Vendor term | Possible project translation | Type warning |
|---|---|---|
| classical configuration $z$ | a contextual fact, a character | only if the configuration algebra is the declared readout context; otherwise it is a hidden variable |
| Onsager--Machlup weight $e^{-\mathcal I/2D_2}$ | the measure delivered by a sufficing reason | a measure is not a pointing; it does not actualise an outcome |
| conditional purity given $z$ | determinateness relative to a pointing | established at trade-off saturation only |
| $\mathcal I=(\text{EOM})^2$ | the cost, or residue, of the descent | a cost functional is not yet a descent datum |
| curvature-squared sector | the geometric part of that cost | in the vendor this is a weight on histories, not a stock of anything |
| decoherence of the unconditioned state | accessible distinguishability deficit | see the deficit note ([[conservation-of-causal-charge/relative-distinguishability-deficit]]): a deficit is not a complementary sector until a map is built |
| the classical trajectory | a record in the programme's sense | "record" is this module's gloss, not the sources' word; the vendor has no persistence law, and factive descent and records ([[conservation-of-causal-charge/factive-descent-and-records]]) owns that obligation |
| diffusion coefficient $D_2$ | a response coefficient | quadratic in a tangent; not a charge, and not a Casimir |
| decoherence--diffusion trade-off | a reciprocity between accessibility and disturbance | it is an inequality with a saturating case, not a conservation law |
| no entanglement generated by *local* CQ dynamics | a record cannot serve as an entangling channel | a theorem in the vendor, with locality load-bearing and classical correlation still permitted; "record" is this module's gloss |

The register discipline of [[program-core/ontological-registers|the register declaration]] applies throughout. A probability weight, a response coefficient, an entropy, a charge, and a fact are five types, and the vendor's own care in keeping the Onsager--Machlup action distinct from a Lagrangian is a model of the same discipline applied one level down.

## What is genuinely importable

**The coefficient argument.** That a term is pathological under an amplitude reading and innocuous under a measure reading is a general structural fact, not a fact about gravity. It gives the programme a precise mathematical signature for its own distinction between necessitating and sufficing ground, and it should be recorded in [[sufficient-reason/two-species-of-reason|Two Species of Reason]] as a physical instance.

**The cost functional as a theorem target.** Deriving an equation-of-motion-squared weight from a descent, rather than postulating it, is a well-posed obligation with a recognisable success condition. It is the sharpest thing this vendor offers the programme.

**The order-of-operations warning.** Solving constraints and then adding stochasticity is inequivalent to letting stochasticity act on the full object and recovering constraints afterwards, as [[stochastic-modes]] establishes. The programme takes a quotient early — [[program-core/physical-quotient|the physical quotient]] removes redundant presentation directions before the response geometry is built — and therefore owes the same defence. This is the vendor's most transferable methodological lesson and it is a genuine warning, not a compliment.

**The convex-constraint mechanism.** From [[cosmological-claims]]: a constraint convex in a variable that receives noise acquires a strictly positive one-sided drift. That is general, requires no tuning, and would apply to any programme quantity with the same convexity.

**The two-sided experimental squeeze.** A theory that makes accessibility and disturbance trade against each other is bounded from both directions by unrelated experiments. If the programme's descent has a comparable reciprocity, it inherits a comparable test — and if it does not, it should say why not.

## What must not be imported

The theory's renormalisability is not evidence for the programme's picture. It is a property of a specific action with specific couplings, conditional on unresolved questions about pole prescriptions and positivity, as [[vendor/postquantum-gravity/commentary/standard-physics-audit|the audit]] records. Borrowing the conclusion without the action would be borrowing a slogan.

The cosmological results must not be cited as successes. Neither the rotation-curve nor the phantom-dark-matter calculation delivers what its title suggests, and the second is an honest null result by thirty-one orders of magnitude.

Conditional purity must not be upgraded into a conservation law. It says the conditioned state stays pure. It supplies no continuous symmetry, no moment map, and no flux balance, so the Noether gap of [[philosophy/noether-conservation/where-the-synthesis-fails|where the synthesis fails]] stands undiminished.

And the vendor supplies no actuality. It gives a measure over classical histories and a purity statement conditional on one. Which history obtains is exactly as unexplained as it is in [[sufficient-reason/facticity-and-pointing|Facticity and Pointing]].

## Construction tests

Four questions decide whether the rhyme becomes a relation.

1. **Does conditional purity survive coarse-graining?** Proved at saturation for the fundamental dynamics; unknown after mediating modes are integrated out. If it fails, the descent reading of this theory fails.
2. **Is the classical configuration a fact or a hidden variable?** It is a character of a commutative algebra, which types correctly — but only if that algebra is the declared readout context rather than a posited substrate.
3. **Can the cost functional be derived?** Produce an $(\text{EOM})^2$ weight from a descent over contexts, with the contexts, transport, and effectivity supplied.
4. **Does the programme's descent predict noise?** If the reframing is an interpretation of the same measure, it inherits the same experimental bounds. If it predicts no diffusion, it is a different theory and must say which experiments distinguish it.
